Majors.Note: Major 3's final published shape (frozen retroactively from the baseline as of 3dafebd3, the last commit on the v3 line). Retained ONLY as the diff basis that Major 4's Breaks list is verified against — the v3 line is dead and no Uplink was ever built against it. Frozen at v4.1. NOTE the provenance: an intermediate v4.0 (commit 57daa136) briefly published a DIFFERENT v4 shape (VesselControl.ActionGroups as System.Boolean[]) before the action-group retype was collapsed onto the same Major. That collapse is ratified on ContractVersion.Major's stated grounds — the mod is pre-release, no artifact was ever built against the intermediate v4.0, so exactly one v4 will ever be seen: this one. This ledger entry is that ratification, made explicit and machine-checked. It is frozen: every future v4.x Minor must be additive over this Shape.

Frozen at v5.0. The thermal channel carries kelvin only. HeatShieldTempCelsius was the sole temperature on vessel.thermal not in K, and that inconsistency was actively producing a wrong readout: ThermalStatus read hottestPart.skinTemp (genuinely K) as Celsius, showed it about 273 degrees high, and guarded it with a Celsius sentinel that could never fire on a kelvin value, so a vessel with no thermometer rendered a temperature instead of dropping the row. One unit per channel removes the choice that was being got wrong; Celsius is a presentation unit the client now asks for by name. Sanctioned on the standing pre-release grounds: no external Uplinks, and the app and mod ship together.

Frozen at v6.0. Removed the dead Meta.Confidence (double?). The mod declared it and the serializer wrote it only when meta.Confidence.HasValue, but nothing ever set it on an outgoing frame (the sole Confidence= assignment in the mod was the deserializer reading an incoming frame), so it was always null on the wire and always omitted from the JSON: a slot every consumer had to account for and none could read. A removed member on a wire-visible type is breaking by definition, so it is a Major, not a Minor. Jon approved the removal (2026-08-02). Sanctioned on the same standing grounds as every Major before it: the mod is still pre-release with no external Uplinks, and the app and mod ship together, so no artifact exists that was built against the old shape. See local_docs/design/specs/2026-08-02-units-game-RESOLVED-local-files.md.

Frozen at v12.0: the RealAntennas relocation (uplink-types-out-of-core plan, seventh and LAST step, completing the migration). CommsLinkQuality, CommsDataRate and CommsLinkMargin moved into GonogoRealAntennasUplink.Contract. Unlike the six steps before it this was a PARTIAL extract from a shared file rather than a whole-file move: Sitrep.Contract/Comms.cs stays, holding the shape whichever backend wins the "comms" capability election fills (connectivity / signalStrength / controlState / path / network / delay / link, their nested hop and graph types, and the four enums). Only the three channels the RealAntennas Uplink declares in its OWN manifest and publishes itself, which no election can produce and which never emit without that mod installed, left core. The sharpest boundary case stayed: CommsHop.BandRateBitsPerSec is documented in Comms.cs as a RealAntennas-only per-hop annotation, absent under bare CommNet, and it is still core, because it is a nullable FIELD on a shared type rather than a type of its own. RA-only presence is not RA-only ownership. All three moved types predate the v6.0 freeze and have been carried into every floor since, so all three are genuine type-removed breaks against the Major-11 floor and all three are in Breaks. Frozen as the MAJOR-11 FLOOR MINUS EXACTLY THOSE THREE TYPES, deliberately not as the live reflected shape: subtracting the moved types carries every other frozen member forward untouched, so unrelated drift anywhere else in the contract is still caught rather than silently absorbed by a re-freeze from HEAD. Sanctioned on the standing pre-release grounds recorded on ContractVersion.Major: no external Uplinks exist and the app and mod ship together. The wire FORMAT of comms.linkQuality / comms.dataRate / comms.linkMargin is unchanged, but this step DID change who writes the bytes: core's JsonWriter carried a hand-written case per type, and a core serializer may not reference an Uplink assembly, so the producer now flattens each payload to a dictionary at the publish boundary, the same self-flattening pattern every other Uplink already used. Same JSON, different writer.

Frozen at v13.0: the per-hop RealAntennas rate leaves the shared hop. Removed CommsHop.BandRateBitsPerSec (double?), a RealAntennas-only per-hop number that sat on the ONE comms shape both the vanilla CommNet backend and an elected RA (or future out-of-tree) provider fill. That is the hand-curated-superset anti-pattern the provider extension bag exists to retire: a provider-specific field on a shared type needs a core PR an out-of-tree comms provider cannot land. The forward band rate now rides the RealAntennas uplink's OWN realantennas.hopRates channel, a thin per-hop annotation keyed by the same node ids comms.path uses and joined onto the route client-side by a comm-signal.hop-rates contribution; the rest of RA's per-hop facts already ride CommsHop.Extensions["realantennas"], so the shared hop is finally RA-agnostic. The field predates the v6.0 freeze and has been carried into every floor since, so its removal is a genuine member-removed break against the Major-12 floor, the whole of this Major's Breaks. Frozen as the MAJOR-12 FLOOR MINUS EXACTLY THAT ONE MEMBER, deliberately not the live reflected shape: the Major-12 minors that landed after that floor (CommsHop.Extensions, comms.commandCentre, and the rest) are NOT written into the Major-13 floor, they stay additive-over-the-floor as before, so unrelated drift anywhere else is still caught rather than silently absorbed by a re-freeze from HEAD. Sanctioned on the standing pre-release grounds recorded on ContractVersion.Major: no external Uplinks exist and the app and mod ship together, so no artifact was ever built against the old shape.

Frozen at v14.0: reliability.* becomes model-first. Thirteen members leave the two elected reliability payloads and one new nested type (ReliabilityBudget) arrives, so the shared shape SHRINKS: the summary from six members to three, the part entry from twelve to nine. Worth a Major on three counts. (1) Several removed members could not be filled honestly by anyone: a probability with no horizon is uninterpretable, so ReliabilityFraction and the summary-level minimum over it were, and that minimum was also a min over probabilities of DIFFERENT events since RO's rated horizons diverge by two orders of magnitude between engines; IgnitionsConsumed and DurationConsumed read Kerbalism fields nothing in the installed assembly ever writes, so both were structurally 0.0. (2) Two members named different things in different backends: MtbfHours was fed SECONDS by one provider and a live inverse-rate by the other, and Group was a redundancy-set name in one and the literal 'engine' in the other, so neither could be rendered without knowing who wrote it. (3) The boolean Unmodeled structurally could not say 'I could not tell', so it said the reassuring thing; ReliabilityCoverage replaces it with five states an operator responds to differently. What replaces them is smaller and open where it needs to be: one Condition enum with the provider's own words beside it, a Survival fraction that MUST carry its horizon, and a Budgets list whose dimensions a provider names itself without a core PR. Sanctioned on the same standing grounds as every Major above: the mod is pre-release with no external Uplinks, and the app and mod ship together.
